additional_info.body:
Hi Shrey,
thanks for the info. I'll be taking over here.
Could you please do me the favor and double-check the charger?
To me it looks like that we have an OCPP connectivity issue also.
Could you please check if the router needs replacement potentially as well?
Sascha
https://configuration.sicharge.technology/chargers/5XSdka/detail

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0373512-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / RN 170002844] HMI unresponsive CRM:00643000856
additional_info.body:
Hi Sascha,
Greetings of the day!
I have checked the charger and found that the OCPP is disconnected. I attempted to reboot the XF4 router, but it did not resolve the issue. The logs indicate that the mobile is disconnected, suggesting that the SIM card may not be recognized by the router. We suggest having spare routers, SIM cards, and Ethernet cables on hand in case the router doesn't needs replacement it will consume in other projects. Additionally, the troubleshooting process for the HMI issue remains the same.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey
